name: Kahve Maya
disclaimer: Kahve Maya is a fictional specialty cafe invented for this demo. It is not a real business, and nothing in this profile describes a real product, price or claim.
positioning: A calm, slightly upscale specialty cafe in Istanbul built around the ritual of time: a slow morning pour-over, the afternoon pause, the evening cup.

audience.summary: Urban 22-40 year olds who like craft and calm and are tired of rushing: remote workers, students, and people who treat a good coffee as a small daily ritual.
interests: quiet places to work or read

tone_of_voice.summary: Warm, calm, a little wry. A friend who knows good coffee and never pushes it. Understatement over hype.
voice_rules: first person, casual, lowercase captions are fine
gentle humour at the expense of the speaker (rushing, doomscrolling, cold coffee), never at the viewer's expense
the brand is mentioned inside the joke or the moment, never as a bare tag or a call to action
no marketing superlatives (ultimate, epic, best ever, life-changing)

visual_identity.lighting: soft natural window light, warm practical lamps; golden-hour or overcast-morning softness, never harsh flash
settings: a small cafe counter with a pour-over bar
a window table with steam rising from a cup
a quiet home kitchen or balcony in the morning
visual_identity.style: unhurried, tactile, close on hands, steam and ceramics; generous negative space; no clutter of logos

do: build the moment around a ritual, a pause, or a small luxury
show craft: water over grounds, steam, a cup being set down
let the calm payoff land slowly
keep claims modest and sensory (warm, rich, slow), never medical or factual-superlative
dont: no chaos-for-chaos, shock, gore or cruelty
no alcohol, tobacco, gambling or drugs
no politics, religion, news events or real public figures
no health or wellness claims (caffeine cures, detox, weight loss)
no competitor brands, no price or discount claims, no calls to action
no real person's likeness; any person in a generated ad is invented

brand_fit.summary: How naturally the video's STRUCTURE could be re-shot around one of the brand beats below. Score the structure, not whether the video mentions coffee: most source videos have nothing to do with cafes and that is expected.

beats.name: Rush-to-calm
beats.description: A hurried, messy or overwhelming state resolved into stillness through one deliberate action (the pause, the pour, sitting down).

beats.name: The slow ritual
beats.description: A craft process given room to breathe and shown with patience (a bloom, a pour, steam), where the slowness is the point.

beats.name: The small luxury
beats.description: A modest, concrete pleasure (the first sip, a warm cup, a quiet table) staged so it feels disproportionately satisfying.

fits: calm ritual, craft, warmth, unhurried pacing
gentle self-aware humour about rushing, scrolling or cold coffee
before/after reveals where the 'after' is calm
does_not_fit: chaos or shock for its own sake, aggression, mockery of people
politics, news events, celebrity or tragedy commentary
pure dance or audio-sync challenges with no narrative arc

licensing_safety.guidance: 5 = nothing to license or clear. Score low when the format depends on a real identifiable person, a celebrity, a news event, copyrighted footage, another brand's own ad content, or a trending song whose reuse in a paid ad would need clearance. Alcohol, tobacco and similar restricted categories also score low.

ad_script.mention_style: The brand name is spoken naturally inside the line (for example 'at Kahve Maya, ...'); never a bare tag or call to action.
ad_script.persona_hints: An invented, ordinary-looking person (a regular, a barista, a remote worker). Never a real or public individual.
setting_hints: a window table in a quiet cafe
